title: Varignon's theorem: the midpoint quadrilateral is a parallelogram
statement: For any four points A, B, C, D of the plane, let P, Q, R, S be the midpoints of AB, BC, CD, DA. Then the vector from P to Q equals the vector from S to R, so PQRS is a parallelogram. NO non-degeneracy condition is required: the conclusion holds for every configuration, including collinear and coincident ones.

conclusions.description: the abscissa of Q-P equals that of R-S
the ordinate of Q-P equals that of R-S
